1.  A researcher wants to test whether a new diet increases growth rate in fish. They put 30 fish in one large tank with the new diet, and 30 fish in another tank with the standard diet.
2.  A field ecologist wants to know if a pesticide affects pollinator visits. They spray one field and leave a neighboring field unsprayed, then count pollinator visits at 20 flowers in each field.
3.  A greenhouse study assigns fertilizer treatments to pots by simply giving the new fertilizer to whichever pots were closest to the watering can.
